feedback.improved: Today was a rather hectic day. In the morning, I went to the university by bus because my motorbike had broken down. The bus was extremely crowded, and I felt quite tired. In the afternoon, I studied English with my friend in the library; we learned many new words and practised speaking. After that, I cooked dinner for my family and made pho. Everyone said it was delicious. I am happy because I learned a lot, and tomorrow I want to commute by bicycle.

mistakes.why: The story is about yesterday, so you need the past simple tense.
'Crowd' is a noun; you need the adjective 'crowded' here.
The past tense of 'feel' is irregular and is 'felt', not 'feeled'.
Keep your past tense consistent since you are talking about earlier today.
Avoid joining two complete sentences with just a comma; use a full stop or conjunction.

feedback.next_step: Practise using regular and irregular past simple verbs correctly in your paragraphs.
feedback.overall: Hello! You have written a nice, honest diary entry about your busy day, and it is great to see you trying new words. Just be careful with your past tense verbs and spelling, and try to write a little more next time to reach the word count.
strengths: Clear chronological story from morning to night
Good use of feelings and direct speech from family
